data.hypothesis: Cancelling the target-mass factor from acceleration, using rsqrtf for inverse distance, and loading the target state once may reduce per-pair work while retaining the one-thread-per-output mapping. Correctness and speed remain unmeasured for this candidate.
data.notes: Only src/nbody_kernel.cu changes; src/launch.json remains unchanged. This is a hypothesis, not a measured speedup; the controller must run the full correctness suite and measure all objective sizes.
transformations: Load the target Particle once and reuse it for interaction calculations and output state.
Replace sqrt and division by distSq*sqrt(distSq) with rsqrtf(distSq) cubed.
Algebraically cancel the target mass in the acceleration sum; preserve input mass by copying it unchanged to output.
